title: Temporal structure tunes the psychedelic experience
title_zh: 时间结构调节迷幻体验
abstract: Human brain activity under psilocybin contains latent temporal structure that improves alignment with ongoing context and covaries with the subjective quality of the psychedelic experience.
abstract_zh: 在裸盖菇素作用下的人类大脑活动包含潜在的时间结构，提高了与持续语境的对齐度，并与主观的迷幻体验质量相关。
snippet: Human brain activity under psilocybin contains latent temporal structure that improves alignment with ongoing context and covaries with the subjective quality of the psychedelic experience.
